purpose: Test whether denser complete correlated owner rollouts improve realized long-run choices at the already diagnosed development conditions.
candidate: Same H32 and owner with twelve model seeds. Combine paths before personality gates; no action voting.
rules: No personality, purpose band, world model, future policy, horizon or game-rule changes. Actual world seed and events matched; both arms run on the same host with separate frozen sources, RNGs and learners.
selection: These two known development conditions are diagnosis, not fresh confirmation or evidence of universal superiority. Inspect final purpose, evaluator-only Bellman opportunity loss, all adverse choices and persona gates. Do not replace the fixed primary H32/three-seed candidate or reuse its confirmation outcomes to accept a changed candidate.
